speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis. The combination of drenching night sweats, significant weight loss, elevated LDH, and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy is highly suggestive of disseminated tuberculosis, even with a normal ESR. Please review the requested Chest_X-Ray images to look for pulmonary involvement or hilar adenopathy to confirm the diagnosis.
